generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Advance Pitting Work 1.Shimpewadi FS No 3, 29 2.Tivoli FS No 105 3.Londa FS No 9/A Londa Range

itemList.description:
Survey and Demarcation of Planting Areas : Survey and
demarcation of plantation boundary lines after clearing
the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas width:-
Sparse under growth.

Excavation of pits with vertically cut edges to make an
uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top
soil on the upper side and 2/3rd on the lower side) Hard
soil = Pits of size 0.45m x 0.45m x 0.45m = 1600 Pits per
Ha
Purchase of 12 x 14 guage GI barbed wire including 18% GST

Preparation of fence posts, duly fashioned conical at the
top, debarked and tar coated complete; 2 m length and 38
cm Girth (Wooden post material should be obtained from
dead timber material already available in forest areas or
by singling out of forked poles of appropriate size and
not by cutting live tree).

Transportation of fence posts up to 10 km distance
including loading and unloading charges using hired
vehicle.

Fixing the fence posts after digging pits of 30 cm x 30 cm
x 40 cm depth and consolidation, ensuring firm fixture.

Unrolling and fixing of barbed wire with "U" nails in four
rows, ensuring proper fixture
Cost of polythene bags (1 Kg = 320 Bags) including 18% GST

Procurement of 0.27 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.27
cum. of Sand and 0.54 cum of Redearth i.e. totally 1.08
cmtr. (Ingredient ratio FYM : Sand : Red earth = 1:1:2)

Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and
arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Cost of quality seeds / planting material / wildlings

Pricking out the seedlings from seed beds and
transplanting in the bags.

Watering the polythene-bagged seedlings twice a day. From
15-12-2025 to 31-3-2026
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.

Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion
materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset
fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other
unforseen items and charges.
